title: Material Blend 3-Mix Duo #20 (UV네온+드래곤비늘+공작눈무늬 / UV네온+크리스탈+왁스)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each with her own multi-material blended body.

#1: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 20s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, curtain bangs long straight hair sweeping past the shoulders — her body carries 3 different materials at once, each claiming roughly an equal irregular organic share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. UV-reactive neon bodypaint, invisible under standard light but DNA helix formations in ELECTRIC MAGENTA and CYAN glowing at full intensity under her own dedicated UV blacklight dominates zone 1. dragon scales (large thick armor-plate scales, each one substantial and sharply faceted), BLAZING CRIMSON scale formations, VIVID DEEP EMBER scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow dominates zone 2. peacock feather-eye markings (overlapping feather-barb ridges each converging into a round eye-marking with a raised rim), BLAZING ELECTRIC EMERALD eye-marking centres, VIVID DEEP BLUE radiating barb-ridge detail, every marking standing in true relief dominates zone 3. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft, diagonal or curving rather than a straight line, the materials interweaving and overlapping gradually across an irregular blended border a few inches wide, elements of each scattered into the neighbouring zone, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: full frontal, both hands framing the face, chin raised — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed. A standard hard key light illuminates most of her body; a separate dedicated UV blacklight illuminates the UV-reactive zone specifically, making it glow at full intensity while the rest reads under normal light.
#1: extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever zone that hand falls in.

#2: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, early 30s goddess, wide hip narrow physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — hips so impossibly wide extending beyond frame creating the most extreme hip-to-waist ratio ever, waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, upper body slim emphasizing the dramatic hip explosion, high ponytail swept sleek — her body carries 3 different materials at once, each claiming roughly an equal irregular organic share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. UV-reactive neon bodypaint, invisible under standard light but solar flare formations in ELECTRIC ORANGE and GOLD glowing at full intensity under her own dedicated UV blacklight dominates zone 1. sapphire crystal clusters growing directly out of her own skin, erupting in true three-dimensional relief, each facet casting its own hard shadow, BLAZING SAPPHIRE BLUE crystal points, VIVID SILVER mineral veins dominates zone 2. molten wax flowing and set directly over her own skin, BLAZING DEEP CRIMSON wax streams pooling and hardening, VIVID AMBER translucent drip-ridges catching the light dominates zone 3. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft, diagonal or curving rather than a straight line, the materials interweaving and overlapping gradually across an irregular blended border a few inches wide, elements of each scattered into the neighbouring zone, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: strong hip pop right, both hands pressing sides of hips outward simultaneously arching back to extreme — most extreme wide hip narrow silhouette ever displayed. A standard hard key light illuminates most of her body; a separate dedicated UV blacklight illuminates the UV-reactive zone specifically, making it glow at full intensity while the rest reads under normal light.
#2: extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever zone that hand falls in.

Environment: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient.
All: Extreme macro detail on every material and every blended transition. CRITICAL: all 2 women's legs must show FULL BODY ART coverage from hip to ankle to toe with NO bare untattooed skin visible anywhere. TWO completely different extreme physiques must CONTRAST and DOMINATE every inch of frame. 8K portrait 3:4 aspect ratio.
